title: Common definitions
description: The envelope and the shared types every Atrio artifact builds on (ADR-014). Identifiers are English because the artifact contract is code, not prose; the project language (artifactLanguage) governs the content a team writes, and translation of labels belongs to presentation.

schemaVersion.description: Schema generation of this artifact, monotonic per artifact type. Version N reads N-1 and N-2 and always writes N; N-3 and older migrate through an intermediate release.

ulid.description: ULID in canonical form: 26 characters of Crockford base32, uppercase. The alphabet excludes I, L, O and U, and the first character is bounded by the largest representable timestamp.

timestamp.description: An instant in RFC 3339 form, with offset.

actor.description: Who produced a change: a human, identified by the git identity of the project, or an agent, identified by the display name the project declared for it.

name.description: git user.name for a human; the declared displayName for an agent.

email.description: git user.email. Required for a human: the platform blocks until git identity is complete, so an attributed change always carries both halves of it.

agentId.description: Canonical definition the agent was materialized from.

human.description: An actor narrowed to a person. Deployment and test confirmations are never attributable to an agent.

catalogRef.description: A definition from the global cache, as id@version: an agent, a pack or a flow. Every place that names one — a declaration, a flow being executed, an agent an event is about — says it the same way, because they all point at the same catalog.

permissionCategory.description: The seven categories the core arbitrates (01-definicion-producto.md, section 9). Closed catalog: widening it is a schema change, not a free edit. agents.json declares a level for each one; an authorization event in the log names the one it is about, and a test keeps both lists from drifting apart.

branch.description: A working branch: one task, one branch. The length of the short ULID prefix is fixed by the branch creation rules, not here.

reference.description: A typed pointer to another artifact.

documentEnvelope.description: The reduced envelope of a document's front-matter. It carries identity and schema generation and nothing else: a markdown file is hand-edited, and timestamps or attribution copied there by hand would rot against git, which already knows both (ADR-014, attribution by git identity).

envelope.description: Carried by every JSON artifact. Composed with allOf, so artifacts close themselves with unevaluatedProperties rather than additionalProperties.
